hypothesis.H0: A fixed forward-response model learned from the calibration stream does not improve MAE versus the fixed calibration-mean baseline on all later sensor readings.
hypothesis.H1: A fixed forward-response model learned from the calibration stream improves MAE versus the fixed calibration-mean baseline on all later sensor readings.
hypothesis.scientific_target: Conventional prospective sensor/LED response forecasting and data-lineage verification, not retrocausality.
hypothesis.negative_or_zero_gain_interpretation: Model fails to beat fixed mean; preserve this outcome. It may reflect weak contrast, sensor noise, calibration drift or inadequate model; do not retune after test.

fixed_protocol.hardware_scope: Classic ESP32 MicroPython, low-power LED on GPIO25 with current limiting, 0-3.3V analog light-sensor module on GPIO34 ADC1; exact board and sensor require operator verification.
fixed_protocol.operation: LED commanded by future precomputed random balanced schedule. ADC sampled 5 ms after command.
fixed_protocol.plan: One new 256+256 balanced LED bit schedule with cryptographic SHA-256, unique plan_id, source classes and complete raw frames; schedule published/frozen before physical train.
fixed_protocol.prediction: Two-state sensor ADC means trained on source LED bit delayed by lag 0..4 bins. Select lag using calibration MSE only. Freeze every future test prediction before test acquisition.
fixed_protocol.primary_endpoint: MAE of the fixed trained prediction on all 256 test ADC readings versus MAE of constant mean ADC from 256 training records.
fixed_protocol.primary_decision_rule: Observed model MAE strictly lower than calibration-mean baseline MAE; otherwise report not improved. No significance claim predeclared for this pilot.
secondary_diagnostics: Missing/reordered frames and observed UTC/monotonic clock chronology
Raw file SHA-256 and code Git blobs
fixed_protocol.unobserved_early_time: MicroPython relative microsecond counter. This is not independent wall-clock timing.
fixed_protocol.recorded_absolute_time: Host-received UTC, not optical emission or photodiode event time; must be independently audited for publication chronology.

prospective_steps.name: FREEZE_PLAN
prospective_steps.requirement: Create a fresh balanced schedule with source code revision and public/escrowed SHA before calibration.

prospective_steps.name: REAL_CALIBRATION
prospective_steps.requirement: Manually authorized and checked optical rig, full unfiltered 256-row host/device raw file.

prospective_steps.name: PROSPECTIVE_PRECOMMIT
prospective_steps.requirement: Freeze model and all 256 future predictions into write-once JSON; reference training raw hash and plan.

prospective_steps.name: EXTERNAL_TIMESTAMP_WITNESS
prospective_steps.requirement: An independent custodian verifies published commitment hash, full forecast and service timestamp before first TEST frame. Local self-reported time alone is insufficient.

prospective_steps.name: REAL_HOLDOUT_CAPTURE
prospective_steps.requirement: Run the complete 256-row test sequence exactly once after witness gate, preserving any failed/incomplete attempt as rejected evidence.

prospective_steps.name: SCORE_AND_REVIEW
prospective_steps.requirement: No refitting, postselection or missing-shot removal. Verify sensor lineage, hashes, timestamp chronology and raw data before publishing results.

prospective_steps.name: APPEND_RESULT
prospective_steps.requirement: Create new results JSON with raw hashes and independent review outcome; never overwrite this registration or LIGHT-007.

scientific_limitations: Photoelectric sensor readings are not individual photon arrivals or photon flight times.
Timing uncertainty is dominated by 50 ms sampling, firmware switching, ADC, serial transport and local clock drift.
Future LED command sequence is known in advance; prediction does not demonstrate information transfer from future to past.
A runtime JSON label ESP32_USB_CAPTURE is an operator assertion, not an independent cryptographic proof.
External GitHub witness and independent hardware attestation are separate steps not satisfied by the current CI.
No actual photodetector, raw physical data or IBM QPU experiment has been accessed.
next_gate: Authorized operator identifies a compatible ESP32 photodetector rig and validates 3.3V-safe wiring. Perform initial train capture only after plan freeze; no TEST capture until independently witnessed forecast.
